description: Configuration and training area for the Graph RAG powered AI Chatbot.

upload_section.style: Dashed border dropzone, background very light gray, centered icon (upload).
upload_section.text: Drag and drop PDFs, Docs, or enter URLs to train your bot.

test_bot_floating_widget.description: A persistent chat window mockup that allows the user to test the AI's responses instantly after changing settings.
test_bot_floating_widget.layout: Bottom right corner. Standard chat widget UI.

visual_prompt_notes: A settings page for an AI chatbot within a SaaS dashboard. The main area shows a large dashed-line file upload area for 'Knowledge Base' training. Below it is a list of synced documents (PDFs and Links) with green 'synced' status dots. In the bottom right corner of the screen, a floating chat widget is open, titled 'Test your Bot', showing a mock conversation between a user and the AI. Colors: white background, yellow accents, light gray dashed lines.
